My name is Kate and I am a physiotherapist. I graduated from the medical university and I work as a physiotherapist with children and adults. 

YouTube is just a hobby. I thought that it can be nice to share my knowledge with you. So on this channel you will find videos related to health, rehabilitation and physiotherapy. I am a practitioner, so I will share with you my insights and professional experiences. But besides, I’m a huge fan of Evidence Based Medicine, so in every post and movie I make you’ll find references to scientific research.

There are no product ads on this channel (and never will). At most, I will occasionally criticize products that I (and scientists) believe are useless.

Hope you enjoy the content,

Kate
